description: Dept. of Local Government  Northern Province - Notify  the Names of Vice Chairman of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha in Northern Province
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election of a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Delft Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This content specifically relates to electoral processes at the local government level, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including election meetings and procedures.
